title: 2023 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Nasser Al-Attiyah / Mathieu Baumel (Toyota Gazoo Racing) and Kevin Benavides (Red Bull KTM Factory Team)
summary: The 2023 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its Saudi Arabia era: 12 stage towns and bivouacs through Saudi Arabia. Winners — Cars: Nasser Al-Attiyah / Mathieu Baumel (Toyota Gazoo Racing); Bikes: Kevin Benavides (Red Bull KTM Factory Team); Quads: Alexandre Giroud (Yamaha Racing - SMX - Drag'On); Light Prototypes: Austin Jones / Gustavo Gugelmin (Red Bull Off-Road Junior Team USA By BFG); SSVs: Eryk Goczał / Oriol Mena (Energylandia Rally Team).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
